package: K35-T2 cross-channel owner and mutation boundary in Studio upload

result.database: disposable PostgreSQL 17 after all 84 Prisma migrations; tmpfs container removed
result.actors: two distinct Better Auth sessions, two user records, two creator channels and two videos
denials: owner A cannot read or open an upload for channel B's video (404)
owner B cannot read or open an upload for channel A's video (404)
owner B cannot presign parts for owner A's in-progress upload (404)
result.side_effect_checks: before the authorized upload, rejected requests leave zero VideoOriginal rows and zero object-store requests; rejected part presign leaves the rightful original UPLOADING
result.positive_control: owner A completes Studio multipart upload, worker encode and playback API/edge fetch on the same video

limitations: This covers Studio API boundaries, not all public/private reads or every role and state transition.
Replace/delete, crash/retry adversarial cases, browser playback, Cloudflare R2 and a deployed edge Worker remain unverified.
K35-T2 remains partial; K35-T1/T3 and independent review are open.
